add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
spec2def(t2embed.dll t2embed.spec)

# t2embed.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/t2embed-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(t2embed_shims OBJECT main.c stubs.c)
target_link_libraries(t2embed_shims PRIVATE wine libgdi32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libversion libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(t2embed_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(t2embed t2embed-cargo t2embed.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS t2embed_shims psdk)
